mission.posting: A Client has noticed a rival company getting ahead by illegally harvesting client data and selling their information to advertising firms. Put a stop to it.

email.subject: #CLIENT# - Ruined Harvest
email.body:
Agent,
Our company recently noticed a rival company that has been gaining unfair and ILLEGAL advantage in the market by harvesting client data (emails, names, preferences etc) and selling it to advertising firms for a profit. This is obviously unacceptable, both for privacy, honesty and fair-use reasons, but also because of the Data Protection Act of 1998.
We would like to you access their servers and destroy their user detail archive they are selling. We will pursue legal action separately (Evidence is no longer an issue).
Thanks, -#CLIENT#
